description: HubSpot only: when the team's CRM isn't HubSpot, use crm-call-prep. Prepares a focused brief before a sales call or meeting with one person: CRM history, open deals, recent notes, email threads, calendar and company news, with talking points. Use on "prep me for my call with X", "I have a meeting with [person] at [company]", "what do I know about X before my call", "who am I meeting with today", "prepping for X", or a name paired with "call" or "meeting". Not for a whole account (hubspot-account-brief) or a quick record lookup (hubspot-contact-lookup).
